title: Private Multilingual DC City Tour (Spanish, Portuguese, English)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
A maximum of 6 people per booking
Driver does NOT escort the customers to the Monuments. Stops are for pictures and appreciation only. All basic information is given in the vehicle
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Washington, DC on a private 4-hour city tour with a dedicated driver.
You'll visit all the major monuments and landmarks, with the option to conduct the tour in English, Spanish, or Portuguese.

This experience also includes views of residential neighborhoods in Washington, DC, as well as key monuments located in Virginia.
Choose between a morning or afternoon departure, available daily, including weekends and holidays.

Please note: The driver does not escort guests at the monuments. All essential information is shared inside the vehicle, and stops are made solely for photos and appreciation. Pick ups only inside of Washington DC (No metro area). 

We provide bottled water and mints for your comfort during the ride.
